safety: StatusOrbit never acts automatically. Recommended actions still need your confirmation, and force quit stays in professional mode.

observing.title: Learning what is normal
observing.summary: Observing for about {{seconds}} more seconds to avoid treating a brief spike as a problem.

healthy.title: Everything looks normal
healthy.summary: No sustained load, memory pressure, low space, or unusually heavy traffic was found.

attention.title: Your computer may be slowing down
attention.summary: StatusOrbit found possible performance issues ({{count}}). Expand this card to see why.

urgent.title: Something needs attention soon
urgent.summary: StatusOrbit found significant performance issues ({{count}}). Review the evidence before taking action.

observing.title: Building a stable baseline
observing.description: Immediate problems such as low space still appear now; sustained load needs a little more time.

healthy.title: All five checks look clear
healthy.description: If the computer still feels slow, inspect the process list and five-minute trends next.

connectionScan.loading: Scanning active connections at low frequency…
connectionScan.unavailable: Active connections are temporarily unavailable; the traffic check still works.

sustained_cpu.title: Processor stays busy
sustained_cpu.description: Sustained load can make apps respond slowly, increase fan noise, and use more power.

memory_pressure.title: Available memory is low
memory_pressure.description: The system is relying on swap, so switching apps and opening windows may pause.

low_storage.title: {{resource}} is running out of space
low_storage.description: Low free space affects updates, caches, and temporary files and may slow the system.

busy_disk.title: The disk stays busy
busy_disk.description: Heavy reads and writes can slow app launches, file saves, and system responses.

high_network.title: Network activity is unusually high
high_network.description: Downloads, sync, video, or many connections may use bandwidth needed by other apps.

culprit.summary: {{name}} stands out at {{metric}}, grouped from {{count}} related processes.
culprit.system: This is a system component or protected process; quitting it is not recommended.

networkBoundary: This only means traffic or connection volume is high; it does not identify malicious software.

request_close.title: First ask {{name}} to quit
request_close.description: This is the gentlest available action. StatusOrbit verifies the process identity and shows a confirmation before doing anything.

open_cleanup.title: Open Space Cleanup
open_cleanup.description: Preview where space went first. Items placed in the basket are permanently deleted only after explicit confirmation.

open_network.title: Review network activity
open_network.description: Check protocols, states, and endpoints to decide whether this is a download, sync, or traffic you cannot yet explain.

inspect_process.title: Inspect the evidence first
inspect_process.description: StatusOrbit does not offer a direct action here. Verify the app identity, resource changes, and protection reason first.

recommendations.actionUnavailable: StatusOrbit could not safely verify or control this app, so nothing was changed.

actionDialog.title: Ask {{name}} to quit?
actionDialog.description: StatusOrbit will send a normal termination request. This is the gentle action, not force quit.
actionDialog.restartDescription: StatusOrbit will ask the app to quit normally, then reopen its verified app bundle.
actionDialog.safeTitle: Does not delete the app or its files
actionDialog.safeDescription: This only asks the running app to stop and does not clean up its data.
actionDialog.riskTitle: Save anything you are editing first
actionDialog.riskDescription: Whether a save prompt appears depends on the app; unsaved work could still be lost.
actionDialog.stableIdentity: A stable handle is bound to the process you selected and will be checked again before execution.
actionDialog.bestEffortIdentity: This platform can only reduce PID-reuse risk through identity checks. StatusOrbit refuses the action if the process has changed.
